notes: Delivery uses Web3Forms (https://web3forms.com) directly from the browser. Web3Forms documents this access key as public/safe for client-side use (their own abuse protection, e.g. rate limiting, lives on their end) -- see docs/migration/PROGRESS.md's Phase 7 entry. A Cloudflare Turnstile widget gates the submit button client-side (no server-side token verification) as a lightweight bot deterrent. Without a key, forms fall back to a pre-filled mailto: link.
